note: The twelve axes are shared vocabulary. A traveller rates her comfort 1-5 on each; a destination is rated 1-5 for how much comfort it demands on each. A match is a per-axis comparison, so every result explains itself. Destination vectors are authored only from first-hand travel — see docs/04-content-verification.md.
